t: A fast STM32 chip family built for motors, power supplies and signal math.
steps: Buy a NUCLEO-G474RE from the ST eStore for about 20 US dollars.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the STM32duino board package.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB cable.
Pick the Nucleo-64 board and the G474 chip in the Tools menu.
Upload the Blink example and watch the light flash.
Try MicroPython on the G474 for live coding over USB.
Move to the B-G431B-ESC1 kit later to spin a brushless motor.
meta: Wild Open. From $19.74. A few stores.
